name: Perceptyne PR-OMNI
summary: A wheeled semi-humanoid from Hyderabad with two 7-DOF torque-sensing arms on an 800 mm vertical gantry and a four-wheel holonomic base, for industrial pick, place, bolting, assembly and inspection work.

germany.statusNote: Perceptyne (Hyderabad, India) shows a pre-order button and a spec-sheet request form; no German or EU seller, distributor or price found.

notes: Navigation is described as indoor SLAM with dual LiDARs.
End-effector type is not named; the end effectors have tactile sensing.
VR teleoperation is built in for data collection.
A stationary sister model, PR-DUO, has the same arms without the mobile base and is not covered here.

evidence.task: Pick, place, bolt, inspect, test, assemble and insert in factory workflows
evidence.note: Maker's application list; press says its solutions serve EMS and automotive clients, without naming a PR-OMNI deployment.

sources.title: Perceptyne Robots: Engineering India's robotic future
